cohort: 346 patients with uterine fibroids who wished to conceive
finding: Both HIFU and LM can be safely used to treat patients who wish to conceive, with similar pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in rates of cesarean section or natural pregnancy between women who underwent high intensity focused ultrasound ablation for uterine fibroids and those who underwent laparoscopic myomectomy.
